spec_params.label: Side
spec_params.help: Direction of the position taken on a signal.

spec_params.label: Market
spec_params.help: Instrument model; indicator availability is checked by parse().

spec_params.label: Candle size
spec_params.help: Bar size used for signals, stops, holds and exits. Every backtest, sweep and live bot runs on the selected tape.

options.label: 1 month
options.reason: Calendar months are not fixed-width, so the engine cannot apply its gapless-bar and timestamp checks. Use 1w or a fixed number of days instead.

spec_params.label: Universe
spec_params.help: Ticker set the strategy is evaluated over.

spec_params.label: Fresh only
spec_params.help: Fire only on the first bar a condition becomes true.

spec_params.label: Entry conditions
spec_params.help: Composable condition tree evaluated on each closed bar.

spec_params.label: Hours (UTC)
spec_params.help: UTC hours when a signal may fire, measured at bar close. Empty means every hour.

spec_params.label: Days (UTC)
spec_params.help: UTC weekdays when a signal may fire, Monday=0. Empty means every day.

spec_params.label: Dates (UTC)
spec_params.help: Specific UTC calendar dates a signal may fire, measured at bar close. Each entry is an ISO date "YYYY-MM-DD" or an inclusive range "YYYY-MM-DD/YYYY-MM-DD". Empty means every date.

spec_params.label: Max hold
spec_params.help: Bars from entry to the time exit.

spec_params.label: Stop mode
spec_params.help: Stop construction from the signal window or entry.

options.label: Legacy trailing mode
options.reason: stop.mode='trail' was displayed but never implemented. Use exit.trailing instead.

spec_params.label: Stop window
spec_params.help: Signal-window bars used by hh and sig.

spec_params.label: Stop parameter
spec_params.help: Buffer for hh/sig or distance for dstop, in percent.

spec_params.label: Take profit
spec_params.help: Percent from entry. Empty means no take-profit.

spec_params.label: Take profit on close
spec_params.help: Wait for a close through the target instead of filling intrabar.

spec_params.label: Trailing distance
spec_params.help: NATR multiple for the trailing stop. Set a value to enable trailing; delete it to disable.

spec_params.label: Trailing ATR window
spec_params.help: Bars in the NATR used by the trailing stop.

spec_params.label: Resting limit
spec_params.help: Legacy capitulation limit offset, in percent.
spec_params.reason: Only the legacy capitulation path places resting limits; the spec backtester ignores them.

spec_params.label: Exit conditions
spec_params.help: A condition tree that closes the position on the bar it first fires, after the stop and take-profit have had their say.

spec_params.label: Risk per trade
spec_params.help: Percent of equity risked to the stop.

spec_params.label: Notional cap
spec_params.help: Maximum notional as a percent of equity.

spec_params.label: Portfolio weight
spec_params.help: Stored allocation hint; the single-bot engine does not read it.
spec_params.reason: The single-bot backtest and runtime have no portfolio allocation step; this value is stored but has no effect.

spec_features.label: Legacy trailing mode
spec_features.reason: stop.mode='trail' is a no-op; use exit.trailing.

spec_features.label: Resting limit
spec_features.reason: Only the legacy capitulation path places resting limits.

spec_features.label: Live regime filters
spec_features.reason: BTC-bear, regime-veto and ticker filters are applied live; the backtest is unfiltered, so read those results as the strategy before filters.

spec_features.label: Portfolio weight
spec_features.reason: Weights are stored but the single-bot engine never reads them.
